facts.value: Services the End and EndEmpty animation slots by forwarding to ftCo_ItemScopeFire_Anim. If ftAnim_IsFramesRemaining is false, the delegate calls ftCommon_8007D92C for situation-dependent action exit, then ftCommon_8007E7E4(gobj, 1), which invokes ftData_OnItemPickup[fp->kind] only when that entry is non-NULL.

facts.value: Services the AirEnd and AirEndEmpty animation slots by forwarding to ftCo_ItemScopeFire_Anim. On a false ftAnim_IsFramesRemaining result, the delegate calls ftCommon_8007D92C and then ftCommon_8007E7E4(gobj, 1); the latter calls the fighter-kind OnItemPickup entry only if non-NULL. The wrapper introduces no independent completion guard or guaranteed presentation effect.

facts.rationale: Records a TU-wide invariant and important selector boundary without assigning gameplay from numeric names alone.
facts.value: The four transition helpers select End or AirEnd through fn_800D769C, whose exact rule is requested motion plus eight when the current motion_id is at least ftCo_MS_ItemScopeStartEmpty, unchanged otherwise. There is no upper-bound family check or direct ammunition read in this selection. Fresh entries use flags 0/frame 0/speed 1; terrain conversions use 0x0C4C5080 and pass current frame/speed. All four assign fn_800D8378 to take_dmg_cb after the motion change.
